object.attr: UnitFormatterTest.300 sec per km renders as 8-03 in mi mode
object.description: Steps: Run UnitFormatterTest '300 sec per km renders as 5-00 in km mode' and '300 sec per km renders as 8-03 in mi mode'. Expected: 300 s/km reads 5:00 in kilometre mode and 8:03 in mile mode. The 8:03 result is consistent with 1.609344 but does not isolate it (1.61 gives the same text); the four displayed paces are covered by PACE-STS-42.
